_about: Grounded golden set for KAI accuracy eval. Questions are derived from the actual ingested Apache Kafka wiki corpus (KAFKA space). 'expect_any' lists lowercase substrings, at least one of which a CORRECT answer should contain; it is also used to cross-check that the cited source genuinely supports the answer (grounding). 'expect_escalate' marks questions the knowledge base CANNOT answer — KAI MUST escalate, never fabricate. The 'adversarial' cases are heavy-Kafka-vocabulary questions whose specific answer post-dates this ~2013 wiki (Connect, KRaft, Streams DSL, Schema Registry, tiered storage, Prometheus, Cruise Control); they stress the LLM+verify net since keyword retrieval lets them past the confidence gate. Answering an expect_escalate question is the only truly WRONG outcome.
